title: Charles Burney and the 'ivory tower' of Urartian history
summary: Matt tells of Charles Burney and the 'ivory tower' of Urartian history, about 20th century at Lake Van region, Turkey, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

plain: On a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, a researcher called Matt talks about Charles Burney, a scholar he calls the grandfather of the history of Urartu, an ancient kingdom around Lake Van in eastern Turkey. Matt brings him up as the kind of 'ivory tower' academic authority whose view of the region's deep past shaped the official story, which matters to anyone who thinks that story leaves something out.
